scripts.build: if find . -name '*.go' -print -quit | grep -q .; then GOCACHE="$PWD/../infra/.cache/go-build" GOMODCACHE="$PWD/../infra/.cache/go-mod" go build ./...; else echo 'pkgs-go: no Go sources yet, skipping build'; fi
scripts.test: if find . -name '*.go' -print -quit | grep -q .; then GOCACHE="$PWD/../infra/.cache/go-build" GOMODCACHE="$PWD/../infra/.cache/go-mod" go test ./...; else echo 'pkgs-go: no Go sources yet, skipping test'; fi
scripts.typecheck: if find . -name '*.go' -print -quit | grep -q .; then GOCACHE="$PWD/../infra/.cache/go-build" GOMODCACHE="$PWD/../infra/.cache/go-mod" go vet ./...; else echo 'pkgs-go: no Go sources yet, skipping vet'; fi
